purpose: Machine-readable, deliberately conservative public snapshot. Every statement carries an explicit evidence status, and where a public artifact does not exist the gap is recorded instead of being filled in.
exclusions: No location, employer, client, compensation, language-proficiency or contact details are asserted.
No target dates, deadlines or numeric success metrics are asserted for any goal.
No production-readiness, reliability, scale or retrieval-augmented-generation claim is made for any project.
Private filesystem paths are never used as evidence; only public https URLs are allowed.

identity.positioning: Full Stack + Cloud foundation transitioning toward AI Engineering / AI Automation / Agentic Systems
identity.positioning_notes: This describes direction of travel from an existing full stack and cloud base. It is not a job title, not a current role, and not a seniority statement.

claim_status_semantics.demonstrated: Supported by at least one public, checkable artifact that a third party can open.
claim_status_semantics.developing: Partially built or prototype-level. No public artifact yet, or the available public artifact does not cover the full claim.
claim_status_semantics.aspirational: Stated direction or intent. Not started, or started but not verifiable.
claim_status_semantics.insufficient_evidence: No public artifact exists today that could support the claim.

claims.text: Full stack web development with a cloud engineering component is the existing base of this portfolio.
claims.notes: Public evidence is a self-reported profile page. It points to publicly described work but does not independently verify depth or scale.

claims.text: Hands-on cloud engineering practice is part of the existing base, focused on containerised and managed-runtime environments.
claims.notes: Scoped to what the public profile describes. No architecture, cost or reliability outcome is asserted here.

claims.text: Transition toward AI Engineering is in progress rather than complete.
claims.notes: Recorded as direction of travel. No public artifact demonstrates applied AI engineering delivery yet.

claims.text: AI Automation is an intended area of focus going forward.
claims.notes: Intent only. Not demonstrated and not verifiable from any public source.

claims.text: Agentic Systems is an intended area of focus going forward.
claims.notes: Intent only. No agent, tool-use or orchestration artifact is public.

claims.text: The AI Engineering Reliability Lab is a public prototype with deterministic representative answers, bounded citations, insufficient-evidence responses, and request-limit tests.
claims.notes: Public reproduction of an AI API reliability boundary. It does not use a model provider, implement RAG, or claim production operation.

claims.text: A production retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) capability is NOT demonstrated. The prototype does not implement a retrieval pipeline, an evaluation harness, or production operation.
claims.notes: Deliberate negative claim. Any public copy that implies production RAG is contradicted by this entry.

claims.text: Cloud Dashboard now exists as a public reproduction of a cloud observability interface using deterministic synthetic telemetry, tests, and documented limitations.
claims.notes: This demonstrates a public reproduction, not live cloud operations, client infrastructure, or historical work performed for an employer.

claims.text: SaaS MVP is planned work. It is not built, not deployed, and has no public artifact.
claims.notes: Planned/not-yet-public. Must not be presented as a demonstrated project.

claims.text: No years-of-experience figure is asserted. Any such number appearing in historical marketing copy is unverified and must not be reused.
claims.notes: Deliberate negative claim. Guards against copying inflated figures out of unreviewed drafts.

claims.text: The Cloud Dashboard public reproduction has a verified public code repository; the other projects in this snapshot do not.
claims.notes: This entry is limited to the Cloud Dashboard repository and does not validate the other project placeholders from historical drafts.

evidence.title: Public LinkedIn profile
evidence.notes: Self-reported and manually synchronised. It is a pointer to public material, not independent verification of any capability claim.

evidence.title: Cloud Dashboard public reproduction repository
evidence.notes: Publicly inspectable reproduction using deterministic synthetic telemetry. It is not client code, live infrastructure, or evidence of historical employer work.

evidence.title: AI Engineering Reliability Lab repository
evidence.notes: Publicly inspectable deterministic API prototype with bounded citations and fail-closed insufficient-evidence responses. It does not demonstrate production RAG or provider operation.

capabilities_demonstrated: Bounded citation IDs and insufficient-evidence responses
projects.notes: Public reliability reproduction. There is no model-provider call, retrieval pipeline, or production-readiness claim.

capabilities_demonstrated: Deterministic synthetic telemetry and chart series
Unit tests, browser-flow tests, typecheck, build, and privacy scan

projects.notes: Planned work. Not built, not deployed, not public. Must not be listed as a delivered product.

short.statement: Turn the AI chat prototype into a small set of publicly inspectable AI engineering artifacts that a reviewer can open and judge without trusting a description.
open_questions: Which artifacts are worth publishing, and under which public identity?
What level of documentation is acceptable as public evidence?

medium.statement: Build and publish the planned projects so that the AI engineering and automation direction is backed by demonstrable work rather than by stated intent.
open_questions: Which planned project carries the most signal for the intended direction?
What scope is small enough to finish and still be honest about?

long.statement: Establish a defensible position in agentic systems, grounded in published artifacts and in work that was actually delivered rather than planned.
open_questions: What does defensible mean concretely for this portfolio?
Which parts of the intended direction are still aspiration?

disclaimers: This snapshot is a draft and requires human review before any external use.
Statuses describe evidence availability, not personal worth or seniority.
Absence of a claim is not a claim of absence of capability.
When this snapshot and any other document disagree, this snapshot wins until it has been reviewed.
